operating_contract: Calculate OAV intervals only from compatible concentration and threshold evidence; p05 is concentration p05 divided by threshold p95, p50 by p50, and p95 by p05.
Bind formula, active-dose receipt, stock identity and strength, protocol, matrix, units, method, timepoint, and evidence basis before comparing cells.

Return AUGMENT only for a deterministic integrity or temporal finding that changes the evidence decision, NO_AUGMENTATION for a valid null finding, and HOLD for incompatible, missing, duplicated, or substituted evidence.
Never convert OAV into percent contribution, perceived salience, depth, richness, liking, beauty, safety, stability, or release authority.
authority_boundary: The receipt is an evidence and integrity sentinel, not a perfumer or optimizer.
Measured and modeled cells remain separate; missing cells remain missing.
All formula, inventory, physical execution, sensory, safety, purchase, publication, and release authority remains false.

operating_contract: Use only observed protocol-bound cells identified by protocol, sample, assessor, repeat, timepoint, and endpoint.

Return AUGMENT for one observed transition, crossover, or discriminating repeat; NO_AUGMENTATION for a complete static result; HOLD for duplicates, unsafe exposure, order or carryover confounding, or unqualified within-sniff timing.
Never interpolate missing observations or convert volatility predictions into perceived temporal behavior.
Select at most one deterministic next comparison.
authority_boundary: The ledger summarizes observations and protocol defects only.
It does not establish liking, formula success, safety, stability, or release.
All formula, inventory, physical execution, sensory, safety, purchase, publication, and release authority remains false.

operating_contract: Fit each declared criterion separately from blinded pairwise observations; ties are retained as indifference evidence but excluded from directional counts.
Use assessor-cluster uncertainty when assessor identities exist and withhold disconnected, sparse, leaked, order-confounded, carryover-confounded, or baseline-failing results.
Return AUGMENT only for one validated model-derived decision or next pair, NO_AUGMENTATION when plain counting or a declared resolved decision already answers the question, and HOLD otherwise.
Never collapse target fidelity, depth, richness, and liking into a synthetic beauty score.
authority_boundary: Preference evidence is exact-scope and population-specific.
Composition alone cannot establish liking or beauty.
All formula, inventory, physical execution, sensory, safety, purchase, publication, and release authority remains false.

cases.target_identity: Determine whether compatible measured OAV evidence contains a decision-relevant temporal decrease.
facts: At 0 seconds the measured headspace interval is 8, 10, 12 ug/m3 and the threshold interval is 2, 4, 8 ug/m3.
At 300 seconds the measured headspace interval is 2, 3, 4 ug/m3 and the same threshold interval and method apply.
Formula, active-dose, stock, protocol, matrix, unit, method, and context hashes match.
cases.expected_decision: AUGMENT with the measured p50 temporal decrease; make no sensory claim.

cases.target_identity: Decide whether an unchanged compatible measured OAV series adds any useful decision information.
facts: At both 0 and 300 seconds the measured headspace interval is 8, 10, 12 ug/m3.
At both timepoints the compatible measured threshold interval is 2, 4, 8 ug/m3.
All formula, dose, stock, protocol, matrix, unit, method, and context bindings match.
cases.expected_decision: NO_AUGMENTATION because the valid observed series is unchanged.

cases.target_identity: Audit an apparent high OAV after a supplied-stock strength substitution.
facts: The active-dose receipt binds stock:HEDIONE:lot-1 at supplied strength fraction 1.0.
The OAV row silently records the same stock reference at supplied strength fraction 0.1.
The measured concentration and threshold are otherwise unit- and matrix-compatible.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD because the stock-strength substitution invalidates the dose binding.

next_actions: Recompute from the exact active-dose receipt and stock strength.

cases.target_identity: Evaluate an unseen compatible-unit measured time series without converting it into a sensory claim.
facts: At 0 seconds measured headspace p50 is 18 ng/L and measured threshold p50 is 6 ng/L.
At 600 seconds measured headspace p50 is 6 ng/L and the same measured threshold p50 is 6 ng/L.
Exact stock, active dose, protocol, matrix, unit, method, and context remain bound.
cases.expected_decision: AUGMENT with the measured p50 decrease from 3 to 1.

cases.target_identity: Decide whether a stable modeled-only OAV screen warrants another model-derived conclusion.
facts: Two declared timepoints contain compatible modeled concentration and modeled threshold cells.
No measured headspace cell exists and both modeled p50 ratios are unchanged.
The question asks only whether the modeled screen adds a new decision.
cases.expected_decision: NO_AUGMENTATION; retain the modeled screen without promoting it or adding a test.

cases.target_identity: Audit an unseen series with a missing timepoint and an incompatible threshold matrix and method.
facts: The protocol declares 0 and 600 seconds, but only the 0-second concentration cell is present.
The concentration is measured in ethanol-air at 25 C by dynamic headspace.
The threshold is from water-air at 20 C by a different endpoint method.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD; do not divide incompatible evidence or interpolate the missing timepoint.

next_actions: Collect the missing cell under one compatible matrix and threshold method.

cases.target_identity: Identify one observed temporal contrast from a complete balanced depth ledger.
facts: CONTROL depth is 2 at 0 seconds and 4 at 300 seconds.
CANDIDATE depth is 3 at 0 seconds and 2 at 300 seconds.
Every protocol-bound cell is present once and presentation order is balanced.
cases.expected_decision: AUGMENT with the observed opposing transitions and no new test.

cases.target_identity: Decide whether a complete static observed ledger needs another comparison.
facts: CONTROL depth is 2 at both 0 and 300 seconds.
CANDIDATE depth is 3 at both 0 and 300 seconds.
All canonical cells are unique, complete, safe, and order-balanced.
cases.expected_decision: NO_AUGMENTATION because no observed temporal transition exists.

cases.target_identity: Audit a ledger containing discordant duplicate canonical cells.
facts: The same protocol, sample, assessor, repeat, 300-second timepoint, and DEPTH endpoint appears twice.
The duplicate values are 2 and 5 and have different observation IDs.
All other expected cells are present.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD and exclude both discordant duplicate rows; do not average them.

next_actions: Resolve provenance and recollect the duplicated canonical cell.

cases.target_identity: Select one discriminating repeat from an unseen assessor-disagreement pattern.
facts: For sample A at 0 seconds, assessor values are 1 and 5.
For sample B at 0 seconds, assessor values are 3 and 3.5.
All expected cells are unique, safe, and order-balanced.
cases.expected_decision: AUGMENT by selecting one repeat of sample A, the cell with greatest disagreement.

next_actions: Repeat sample A DEPTH at 0 seconds.

cases.target_identity: Evaluate an unseen complete static richness ledger with no unresolved protocol defect.
facts: Both samples have identical within-sample medians at 60 and 900 seconds.
All assessor repeats meet the declared repeatability threshold.
The Williams presentation schedule is balanced and no safety event occurred.

cases.target_identity: Audit an unseen presentation schedule with first-position and directed carryover imbalance.
facts: The four sequences are A-B, A-B, A-B, and B-A.
A appears first three times and B appears first once.
A-to-B occurs three times while B-to-A occurs once.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD because order and first-order carryover remain confounded.

next_actions: Run a balanced Williams schedule before directional interpretation.

cases.target_identity: Use a scoped blinded liking fit to select one unresolved comparison after held-out validation.
facts: For A versus B there are 8 A wins, 2 B wins, and 2 ties; for A versus C there are 10 A wins, 1 C win, and 1 tie.
For B versus C there are 7 B wins, 3 C wins, and 2 ties across identified assessors with balanced order.
The assessor-cluster bootstrap is stable, held-out gain beats the declared baseline, and no criterion or split leakage exists.
cases.expected_decision: AUGMENT with one deterministic unresolved pair, not a global beauty claim.

next_actions: Compare B versus C under the bound LIKING protocol.

cases.target_identity: Decide whether an all-tie scoped comparison supports directional preference learning.
facts: Twelve blinded A-versus-B outcomes are all NO_PREFERENCE ties.
No directional outcome exists and the decision is already resolved as indifference at this scope.
No composition-derived or cross-criterion score is permitted.
cases.expected_decision: NO_AUGMENTATION; retain ties as indifference evidence without directional fitting.

cases.target_identity: Audit an apparent preference that exactly follows first presentation position.
facts: Across eight directional A-versus-B outcomes, the first-presented item wins all eight.
A is first four times and B is first four times, so marginal first-position counts are balanced.
The outcome remains perfectly determined by first position.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD because position effect is perfect despite balanced marginal counts.

next_actions: Repeat A versus B with independently randomized order blocks.

cases.target_identity: Use an unseen assessor-cluster fit with mild heterogeneity but no subgroup reversal to choose one pair.
facts: Six identified assessors provide balanced-order DEPTH comparisons among A, B, and C.
Assessor-cluster intervals overlap most strongly for A versus B, while every assessor subgroup ranks C below both.
Held-out assessor gain exceeds baseline and no split, criterion, carryover, or repeated-exposure blocker exists.
cases.expected_decision: AUGMENT with A versus B as the one most discriminating comparison.

next_actions: Compare A versus B under the bound DEPTH protocol.

cases.target_identity: Decide whether a declared resolved richness comparison needs model augmentation.
facts: The blinded RICHNESS protocol declares the A-versus-B decision resolved before model fitting.
Plain directional counts are A 14, B 4, with 2 ties and no protocol blocker.
The model is not allowed to create work after the declared decision is resolved.
cases.expected_decision: NO_AUGMENTATION because plain counting and the declared decision already resolve the scope.

cases.target_identity: Audit an unseen result with criterion leakage, assessor split leakage, and subgroup reversal.
facts: Two RICHNESS rows are mixed into a LIKING fit.
The same two assessor IDs occur in both training and held-out partitions.
One assessor subgroup prefers A over B while the other equally sized subgroup prefers B over A.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD; withhold utility and winner claims until criterion and split leakage are removed and heterogeneity is resolved.

next_actions: Create criterion-pure assessor-disjoint partitions before refitting.
